findings: Captured brands/categories have only ID uniqueness; categories has parent FK. Neither has normalized-name uniqueness. Browser list-before-insert is not concurrent duplicate protection.

Captured staff-manage RLS uses is_staff() for all authenticated operations. Admin-only BFF creation alone is not proof that all database writers enforce that boundary. Do not silently replace captured grants/policies to obtain a passing fixture.

Hook creation supplies only name; category parent is omitted. Current duplicate match ignores parent and normalizes browser locale/collapsed whitespace, so a new SQL equivalence rule must be explicitly matched and hierarchy ambiguity preserved rather than assumed.
Secure Sheet updateField returns false for edits; ReferenceSelectCell closes creation mode and ignores assignment result. A created reference must not be reported as an assigned product.

Existing Product Master assignment uses paired IDs, reason, expectedUpdatedAt and held operation key; suppliers already have their own reviewed procurement command. Preserve those owners rather than generic direct-write adapters.
